## Description {#details}

<p>Lowering the WWM_COPY instructions for various register classes.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/amdgpu">AMDGPU</a> target generates WWM_COPY instruction to differentiate WWM copy from COPY. This pass generates the necessary exec mask manipulation instructions to replicate 'Whole Wave Mode' and lowers WWM_COPY back to COPY.</p>
